method: Every one of the 18 final pages was rendered and viewed individually at 120 dpi after the final two-model result and proof integration. No clipping, overlap, broken glyph, or unreadable figure/table was found.

pages.notes: Title, abstract and introduction are legible; the unmodified class retains its anonymous title spacing.
Threat model, reference laws, TV definition and section transition fit both columns.
Architecture figure, mechanism-scope table and terminal-information criterion are legible without clipping.
Public-endpoint identity and the three terminal-band displays fit their columns.
Stopping theorem, full-support corollary, explicit Markov bound and finite certificate are readable.
Finite-input counterexample, interval equations and packet-format description fit cleanly.
Guarded-code theorem, proof and implementation settings are readable and correctly aligned.
Exact-audit table and evaluation methods are legible; standard float spacing is retained.
Two-panel finite-effects plot, legends, caption and upstream study methods are clear.
Both-model all-string table shows all twelve rows, confidence intervals, TPR/FPR and denominators.
Four-panel budget-recovery plot, interval shading, axes, legend and caption are clear.
Delivery and endpoint tables, supporting studies and related-work text are legible.
Limitations end on page 13 before the reference section; bibliography entries fit.
Remaining bibliography, open-science, ethics and AI-use statements are readable.
Full-support proof, Poisson identity and explicit Markov calculations fit without overlap.
Verified safe-interval proof and piecewise killed-kernel displays are fully visible.
Finite certificate, exact decimal bounds, negative control and endpoint-approximation proof are legible.
Finite-grid scope, equations and ending fit the final page; remaining whitespace follows normal flow.
